## BlockKeyboard.\_build() method

Build keyboard blocks by calling a method from the linked `LabelKeyboard`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _build(key: string, lang?: string, type?: string, reverse?: boolean): string;
```

</td><td>

</td><td>

_(Optional)_ Reverse button order. If true, reverses comma-separated labels.

**Returns:**

string

Keyboard block string.

## Exceptions

Error if [BlockKeyboard.label](./gramstax.blockkeyboard.label.md) is not set.

Error if the specified method name does not exist in the label class.

## Example


```typescript
// Assuming BlockKeyboard.label = MyKeyboards with backNext() method

const kbk = BlockKeyboard
kbk._build("backNext");
// => '<keyboard type="inline" lang="en">Back, Next</keyboard> ...'

kbk._build("backNext", "en", "bottom");
// => '<keyboard type="bottom" lang="en">Back, Next</keyboard>'
```
